scientific_integrity: Theorem proved for all \(b\ge2\) and \(h\ge0\) via exact state recurrences, published forest homotopy results, a direct domination argument, and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz computation; two finite standalone checkers are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary independence complexes of full rooted trees and the root-preserving group action on reduced integral homology are treated. The nonequivariant homotopy classification is already known. An inaccessible related article leaves bibliographic risk.
title: Orientation characters of independence-complex spheres of full rooted trees
